title: Section 4 BSA — Relevancy of facts forming part of same transaction

content.heading: Relevancy of facts forming part of same transaction
content.text: Facts which, though not in issue, are so connected with a fact in issue or a relevant fact as to form part of the same transaction, are relevant, whether they occurred at the same time and place or at different times and places. This is the successor of Evidence Act section 6.
